description:
Pre-match press conference with Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick ahead of Manchester United v Brighton & Hove Albion in the Carabao Cup third round.

Carrick discusses the value of trophies and the challenge of balancing squad changes with the need to progress after a demanding run.

He reflects on the controversial goal decision in the Manchester derby, United’s points return and whether the setback can sharpen his players’ response.

Carrick also provides fitness updates on Luke Shaw, Amad and Matthijs de Ligt before discussing Patrick Dorgu and new signing Carlos Baleba.
